messages:
Maya (CSM): Starting Pioneer Health onboarding thread. Goal: get triage assistant into limited pilot in 28 days. Need stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and quick wins.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): I can take integration + perf. Do they need Dedicated or Private?
Sam (Pioneer Health - Eng): Must be VPC for PHI. Also legal wants embedding retention off by default.
Priya (Onboarding PM): Draft 4-week timeline: Week 0 access & infra; Week 1 API integration + smoke; Week 2 quality tuning + training; Week 3 pilot w/ clinicians + feedback; Week 4 go/no-go & renewal recommendation.
Maya (CSM): Success metrics: p95 < 300ms for clinician flows, 3 automated workflows, pilot NPS >= 7, security sign-off. I'll make the checklist.
onboard-bot: Workspace created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/pioneer-330 (team access)
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Quick curl for smoke test:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mpt-lite","prompt":"Summarize note","max_tokens":128}'
```
I'll post baseline numbers by Tue.
Sam (Pioneer Health - Eng): Okta SSO metadata will be sent today. We'll nominate 6 clinician power users for pilot.
Priya (Onboarding PM): Risks: VPC networking window, legal encryption sign-off, clinician availability. I'll publish a one-pager and update daily.
Maya (CSM): Owners: Ethan -> integration & perf; Priya -> timeline & risk; Maya -> success criteria & survey; Sam -> SSO & users. Training proposed Thurs 9am PT. Please confirm. :thumbsup:
_meta: format: slack thread; single 'messages' string with chronological messages
